shortDescription: Import/Delete SSL keys and certs from BIG-IP

options.name: cert_content
options.description: Sets the contents of a certificate directly to the specified value. This is used with lookup plugins or for anything with formatting or C(content) must be provided when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: cert_name
options.description: SSL certificate name. This is the cert name used when importing a certificate into the BIG-IP. It also determines the filenames of the objects on the LTM.

options.name: issuer_cert
options.description: Issuer certificate used for OCSP monitoring. This parameter is only valid on versions of BIG-IP 13.0.0 or above.

options.name: key_content
options.description: Sets the contents of a key directly to the specified value. This is used with lookup plugins, or for anything with formatting or templating. This must be provided when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the key and/or cert is uploaded to the device. When C(absent), ensures the key and/or cert is removed from the device. If the key and/or cert is currently in use, the module will not be able to remove the key.

options.name: true_names
options.description: When C(true), the module does not append C(.crt) and C(.key) extensions to the given certificate and key names. When C(false), the module appends C(.crt) and C(.key) extensions to the given certificate and key names.
